_comment: Copy this file to metadata-instances.json and replace placeholders with real values. The real file is excluded by .gitignore and must not be committed. api_key is the bearer token of the tdai kernel gateway, obtained from the kernel side. proxy_endpoint is optional and only affects the 'client access endpoints' display in the UI; when running open-source core and proxy separately, set it to the proxy's external address (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8096); omit it when a gateway fronts the proxy in production/intranet deployments.

instances.name: E2E automation testing only (database may be wiped at any time)
